exposure: Robson classification groups (I, II, V, VI, IX)
outcome: Contribution of Robson groups to overall CS rate
cohort: The study included all women undergoing cesarean deliveries with a gestational age of more than 28 weeks at Government Medical College, Mahasamund, Chhattisgarh, India, between September 2022 and August 2023.
finding: The overall cesarean section (CS) rate was 41.26%, with Robson groups I, II, and V contributing to 80.18% of the total CS rate, and Group V, VI, and IX showing particularly high CS rates within their categories.
mod_finding: The primary findings quantify the contribution of specific Robson classification groups to the overall cesarean section rate, identifying groups I, II, and V as major contributors, and highlighting high CS rates in nulliparous breech presentations (Group VI, 82.86%) and women with prior CS (Group V, 94.75%).
